notes.title: Celebrating 10 Years of Enhance!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43005846/bc313fba6256fb202dc9e08dec40cbf36fbb0ffc.jpg

Presenting Sounds & Visions: Enhance at 10

Happy 10th anniversary to us!

Formed in 2014 by visionary Tetsuya Mizuguchi, Enhance is synonymous with transcendent interactive experiences that blur the line between video games, art, sound, and design. From the pulsing techno space-scapes of Rez Infinite to the expansive, ever—evolving visuals and challenge of Tetris® Effect: Connected and games like Lumines Remastered, and HUMANITY, Enhance occupies a wholly unique place in the culture of interactive entertainment.

To mark the 10 year anniversary, we are collaborating with Cook and Becker and Lost In Cult Records to present SOUNDS & VISIONS: ENHANCE AT 10—a celebration of the sights, sounds, works and stories that have defined the first decade of our company.

Presented here for the first time are the extensive musical archives, in-depth oral histories and future visions of Enhance—brought to life in a limited edition collection.

The Sounds and Visions: Enhance at 10 collection offers two unique boxed sets, each with its own special content. These sets can be purchased individually or together. Both sets are available to pre-order exclusively at cookandbecker.com until December 10, 2024.

notes.title: "Singularity X (Area X tracks from Rez Infinite)" Soundtrack by Hydelic
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30287715/769008fa6217c391d4149d1cbb76a516a4cd6bfe.jpg

“Singularity X (Area X tracks from Rez Infinite)” is the complete Area X album by award-winning musical artist Hydelic.

 Includes new unreleased tracks (12 tracks total)
 Orange vinyl encased in a gradient slipcover viewable through “X” cut-outs
 Album art designed by Cory Schmitz

Area X is the debut work for Hydelic, which earned several nominations including Best Music/Sound 
Design at The Game Awards (2016), Audio Achievement at the BAFTA Game Awards (2017), and Best Audio at the Game Developers Choice Awards (2016).

The album takes the listener on an energetic and emotional journey through the layers of Area X.

The vinyl by iam8bit is now shipping and a digital release for purchase on Bandcamp will be available starting August 6, 2021.

===

FREE SOUNDTRACK DOWNLOAD FOR DIGITAL DELUXE DLC OWNERS
A free digital download of the soundtrack is available to everyone who owns the Digital Deluxe DLC on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/689950/Rez_Infinite_Digital_Deluxe_DLC/
Instructions on how to download are below:
[olist]
 If you already own the Digital Deluxe DLC on Steam, update the DLC in your library to the latest version.
 The DLC can be found where your Steam games are downloaded to on your computer in the folder “Digital Deluxe Bonus Extras.”
 Folder: \SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Rez Infinite
[/olist]

notes.title: DSFix patch creator Peter "Durante" Thoman launches PC port studio
notes.content: Peter "Durante" Thoman has announced he's opening a new studio dedicated to PC ports, PH3 Games.Durante - who has already lent his expertise to PC ports of The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel and Rez Infinite - is well-known in the PC modding circuit, and arguably best known for his PC Dark Souls patch. According to a post on Metacouncil forum, the venture's been around since last September, but he's only recently "got the final bureaucratic IDs required to consider it fully complete". It's called PH3 Games so that it's "somewhat pronounceable" in both English and German, and all three co-founders have a PhD. That said, Durante acknowledged the team was "still considering several alternatives". Specialising "in the engineering aspects of game development", PH3 Games will provide "renowned high-quality ports, as well as consulting related to performance aspects: optimization, parallelization, refactoring and tuning". Read more…

notes.title: Rez Tips #3: High Score Strategies, Multiple Endings
notes.content:
We'd like to thank those who have been posting in our community pages. There are some new ones that show your dedication! Most secrets of Rez Infinite require the completion of a certain task, but some of them are unlocked based on play time. We're happy to see players go beyond.

These Rez Tips are meant to be as spoiler free as possible, but fellow players have shared their findings around the internet if you're really curious ;)

Direct Assault Mode
What is Direct Assault? In this mode, play all of the levels in normal mode back to back with different orchestrations of enemies and increasing difficulties as you progress. Every time Direct Assault is completed, experience Rez Infinite in different color schemes as they unlock with each successful playthrough.

https://media.giphy.com/media/3ov9jGhGtcGPGv8ISc/giphy.gif

High Score Strategies
Having trouble increasing your high score in Score Attack mode? Learn the pattern of enemy formation--the more enemies you lock onto at one time, the more points you get. Hit different parts of larger enemies before taking them down, and shoot down their missiles for extra points. Go to Options and enable Point Display to see what’s worth more points and help you strategize higher scoring combos.

Professional Screenshots/Video Capture
Take professional-looking screenshots or capture clean video in Areas 1-5 without the UI by going to Options > Game Settings and turning “Heads Up Display” OFF.

Multiple Endings
You beat Areas 1-5 and Area X on your first playthrough, but did you get all the endings? ;)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30287715/8dafea2caf4306ac0ce49c53b0a81a03809ccdd9.jpg

notes.title: Rez Tips #2: Ultrawide and 4:3 Monitor Support, Best HTC Vive Settings, and more!
notes.content:
Hi again! We hope everyone found our last Rez Tips post useful. There are many things to unlock in Rez and we don’t want to give away all the secrets just yet ;)

We hope our fans can discuss their progress and achievements in our Steam forums, Twitter, Reddit, or your favorite internet hangout and help those who are curious. We’ve already seen some great screenshots shared on Twitter and our community hub here!

Ultrawide (21:9) and 4:3 Aspect Ratio Support
For those who weren’t with us from the beginning, we heard the rumblings of the community and added support for fans who have 21:9 ultrawide monitors! At the same time, we added 4:3 support.

https://i.redd.it/956mex128bgz.png
(Thanks to HadynTheHuman on Reddit for the screenshot)


HTC Vive Auto Rotation and Reticle Settings
In VR options we have "Area X auto-camera rotation" ON/OFF. This is ON by default, but turning this OFF will disable the original camera design of Area X where the camera continues to turn in whatever direction you're looking. We also learned many people feel more comfortable setting VR Control Type to Type 2 (use only the controller to move the reticle). To do so, go into VR Options > VR Control Type > Type-2

Some people say that turning Area X auto-camera rotation OFF with VR Control Type-2 works very well on Vive. Please try it out!


Trance Vibration
Did you know you can feel the gameplay even more in Rez Infinite? In Options > Controls you can turn on Trance Vibration (default is OFF) and connect other controllers to your PC (that support vibration). Enhance the experience more with headphones!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30287715/02658afa065949ba5991b9aed7ceb388a8592bdf.jpg


Traveling Mode
If you just want to enjoy the environments without worrying about losing your progress, try Traveling Mode to play at your own pace with no game overs. (Notice your player form is green!)

https://media.giphy.com/media/xT9IgoKIeIkqFgQPLi/giphy.gif


More Rez Tips are coming in the following weeks. Let us know in the comments if you have any questions about any modes or features!

notes.title: First-Person Mode, View Mode, and More Rez Tips!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Wow, it’s been a month since launch and as always, we really appreciate your support! Hardcore fans of Rez may have already found these “hidden” features, but these tips can be helpful to those new to the game. Here’s a taste of some things you can do/unlock in Rez Infinite.

Some of these were already announced on our Twitter, but there will be more to come!

View Mode
Rez Infinite has a feature called View Mode. While playing in any level, press V on your keyboard, or LB on the gamepad to pause gameplay and look around. In desktop mode, use the left joystick, or hold left click and drag the mouse to look around. In VR, move your head to look around. Exit view mode by pressing V.

https://media.giphy.com/media/l1J3wGARDBMgGuCly/giphy.gif

3D Depth Settings
For more 3D-ness in Areas 1-5, try the new 3D Depth settings under VR Options. “Standard” is the default, and "Increased" and "Max" increases the level of 3D depth, making the environment feel more immersive.

https://media.giphy.com/media/l378bueaPUhcJ8uSA/giphy.gif

Extra Modes
There’s more to Areas 1-5 and Area X! Unlock secret modes and check your progress in the main menu under Rez > Beyond. Have you tried Lost Area?

https://media.giphy.com/media/3ov9jGUwdFw6jRGUkE/giphy.gif

New PC Graphics Options
Rez Infinite comes with many graphics options to fit your PC rig. Try different settings to see which ones look best.

https://media.giphy.com/media/l1J9OfNsdFiRTDBbG/giphy.gif

First-Person Mode
Are you up to the challenge? Long time players of Rez, the secret of how to unlock it hasn’t changed. Let us know in the comments if you’ve unlocked this special mode!

https://i.ytimg.com/vi/D6_frmFMAK8/maxresdefault.jpg
(Image from Rez Infinite player Joseph)

notes.title: Rez Infinite Patch 1.06 (8/29/17)
notes.content:
Right after our trip to Gamescom, we spent some time this week preparing for PAX. (If you're there, find us at the Oculus VR Village.) We're sorry about the delay on these patch notes, but our team heard your concerns, and from what we've been reading, we're really happy the 3D depth setting has been well received so far!

Rez Infinite Patch 1.06 (8/29/17)
--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------
Added “3D Depth” option in VR Settings for those wanting to boost the “3D-ness” of the graphics there. “Standard” is the default and the same as before, so if you want to try it out please go to VR Settings > 3D Depth > and choose either “Increased” or “Max”.
Fixed issue where upper-left-side text was cut off in certain resolutions. 
Adjusted the audio mix / balance of certain sound effects.
If you have any technical issues and you can't find the answer on our support page or elsewhere in our forums, we’ll be monitoring our Technical Issues Sub Forum.

Thanks as always for supporting us! Have a great weekend :)

notes.title: Rez Infinite Patch Update (8/17/17)
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Thanks for being supportive during our week of launch. We're really happy that many people have been reporting their issues have been solved!

Since our last news update, we've released two patches (1.04 and 1.05) with 21:9 ultrawide support added and looked into the Area X 3D depth on Oculus VR mode. We also looked into random crashes which hopefully helps those with that issue.

Let us know if these patches worked in the comments, or on our main Technical Support Thread.

Rez Infinite Patch 1.05 (8/17/17)
--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------
Updated the menu cursor handling in menus/results that may have led to an indefinite lock up in the game on certain cases.
Worked on Area X 3D depth in Oculus VR.

Rez Infinite Patch 1.04 (8/15/17)
--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------
Fixed issue causing crashes on certain video cards.
Added support for 21:9 and 4:3 resolutions. (Please let us know if it works for your setup!)
Worked on audio balance issue.
--------PLEASE NOTE--------
If you’re experiencing slowdown, please try adjusting the video settings in-game to find what works best for your setup. (For example, lowering MSAA Filter can often improve performance in Classic Rez.)

Rez Infinite Patch 1.03 (8/11/17)
--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------
Fixed taskbar showing up on Windows 7 full screen mode when playing on mouse/keyboard.
Fixed X1 and X2 mouse binding not working in Area X.
Worked on the ultrawide monitor issue. Please let us know in the comments if this worked for your setup.

Rez Infinite Patch 1.02 (8/10/17)
--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------
Fixed issue for some configurations that were having problems (not launching, or crashing repeatedly back to menu, etc.) due to the game not targeting best-performing GPU. We will continue to monitor and work on this issue as needed.
Fixed issue with VR control type 3 where the targeting reticle would disappear when looking behind yourself.
Fixed issue with VR control type 3 where the camera was behaving incorrectly at the Area 2 boss.

Rez Infinite Patch 1.01 (8/9/17)
--------ISSUES WE ADDRESSED--------
 Fixed black screen/display monitor issue. We just released a patch that will hopefully fix the issue related to the display monitor and refresh rate that was preventing you from proceeding. Please confirm if this fixed your issue by replying here. If not, we’ll continue working hard on this.
To those still with the black screen / flashing mouse pointer issue: 

Can you let us your OS/CPU/GPU/Display Monitor specs below and mention this issue?

Can you also try to  verify your game cache files?
If a game won't launch, this is often caused by corruption in your extracted game files.

Right-click Rez Infinite in your Steam Library > Properties
Click "Local Content" tab
Click "Verify Integrity of Game Cache..."

We’ll continue to read posts in our Technical Issues area in our forums for any other bugs you find. Thanks again for everyone’s support!
